featured_reviews.review_text: I appeared at this centre for a competitive examination. I would suggest carrying a completely transparent water bottle, such as a Bisleri bottle, because coloured transparent bottles are not allowed inside the exam hall. Also, only transparent pens are permitted, so make sure to carry transparent-bodied pens. In addition, carry all necessary documents, including photocopies (xerox) and passport-size photographs. The nearest xerox shop is a bit far from the centre, so do not assume you can get photocopies done at the last minute. Entry may not be allowed if the required photocopies are missing. Being prepared in advance can save you a lot of unnecessary stress on the exam day.

featured_reviews.name: Ameer Shaik
featured_reviews.review_text:
It’s a memorable moment to enter into this IIT. It’s been a 5-month-long journey of NEC, and after that we secured the 156th rank in the Basic Track of the NEC Challenge, which itself is a proud achievement for us—especially because my college is new to these kinds of national-level challenges. Stepping into IIT Bombay after this journey felt unreal and deeply satisfying.

Attending E-SUMMIT 2K25 at IIT Bombay was nothing short of inspiring. From the moment we entered the campus, the environment itself motivated us to think bigger, dream bolder, and work harder. The infrastructure, innovation culture, and energy of the place clearly show why IIT Bombay is a global hub for entrepreneurship and technology.

The sessions, speaker talks, startup showcases, and interactions with entrepreneurs and mentors were extremely insightful. Listening to founders, investors, and industry leaders share their real-world experiences gave us clarity on how ideas turn into impactful startups. The exposure we gained here cannot be measured in words—it reshaped our mindset towards problem-solving, leadership, and innovation.

For a student coming from a college that is still growing in such ecosystems, this experience was truly empowering. Representing our institution at such a prestigious platform and standing among students from top colleges across the country gave us confidence and motivation to aim higher. The coordination, hospitality, and professionalism of the E-SUMMIT organizing team were excellent, making the entire event smooth and memorable.

Overall, IIT Bombay E-SUMMIT 2K25 was not just an event for us—it was a life-changing experience. It strengthened our belief that with consistency, teamwork, and vision, even students from new colleges can compete, learn, and grow on national platforms. This journey will remain a milestone in our academic and entrepreneurial life, and IIT Bombay will always hold a special place in our hearts.

⭐ Truly an unforgettable experience and a dream destination for every aspiring innovator and entrepreneur

featured_reviews.name: Utkarsh Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am currently inside the campus of Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, participating in Techfest on 22 December 2025, and the experience has been truly unforgettable. IIT Bombay is not just an educational institute, it is an ecosystem of innovation, discipline, and excellence. The campus is vast, green, and beautifully maintained, offering a calm and inspiring environment despite being located in the heart of Mumbai.

Techfest reflects the true spirit of IIT Bombay. From advanced technology exhibitions and robotics challenges to insightful talks and competitions, every event is well-organized and intellectually stimulating. The level of creativity, technical depth, and teamwork displayed by the students is outstanding. You can feel the passion for learning and problem-solving everywhere on campus.

The energy during Techfest is electrifying, with participants coming from different parts of India and even abroad. Volunteers and coordinators are extremely helpful, making the experience smooth and enjoyable. The infrastructure, hostels, academic blocks, and open spaces all reflect world-class standards.

Being here is highly motivating and gives a clear picture of why IIT Bombay is considered one of the finest institutions in the country. A truly inspiring place for anyone interested in technology, research, and innovation.

featured_reviews.name: ANKIT J KASHYAP
featured_reviews.review_text:
IIT Bombay is an excellent institute known for its academic excellence as well as for organizing high-quality and well-managed events. The campus is very beautiful, spacious, and has a great environment. During the fest, people from many different countries come to participate, which gives an international-level exposure.
The fest is organized only in December and is conducted for 3 days. In these three days, a large number of exciting and informative events take place. Army weapons are displayed, advanced robots are showcased, and events like Robo War, Robo Car Racing, and many other technical competitions are organized. These events are extremely interesting and educational, especially for IT and engineering students.
Along with technical events, there are many other activities that make the fest engaging and energetic. The registration process is smooth and is open from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM, which is very convenient for participants.
Overall, IIT Bombay is an amazing place that provides learning, innovation, technology exposure, and global interaction all at one place.
Highly recommended for students interested in engineering, robotics, and technology. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

These experiences brought back a sense of belonging while reinforcing how time may pass quickly, but meaningful relationships and ideas continue to evolve and strengthen.

Overall, the visit was not just a reunion, but a thoughtful pause, combining learning, reflection, and the enduring value of shared journeys.

The IIT Bombay campus immediately stands out for its scale, greenery, and how well maintained it is. Despite being massive, it feels calm, structured, and easy to navigate.

Once inside the campus for the summit, the experience became even more impressive. Internally, the event was very well organized...clear directions, smooth coordination, and volunteers who actually knew what they were doing. You could tell that a lot of people were working seriously behind the scenes to make the summit run smoothly.

The startup expo and network arena were the strongest parts of the summit. They felt purposeful rather than crowded or random, and the interactions were meaningful. The overall vibe was energetic but controlled, which is rare for events of this scale.

From my experience, the summit didn’t feel rushed or poorly managed at any point. The infrastructure of the campus supported the event well, making movement, networking, and participation comfortable throughout the day.

Overall, the combination of a well-run internal summit and a disciplined, well-kept campus made the experience genuinely positive and worth attending.

From the very first day, the atmosphere of the department felt positive and inspiring. The campus environment encourages students to focus on learning while also exploring their own potential. “Every setback is a setup for a comeback” became my personal motto.

The friendships I made here, the guidance I received, and the experiences I gained will always remain close to my heart. The department became my second home, where I learned not only academic lessons but also life lessons. It taught me patience, perseverance, and professionalism.
Thank you SNDT

featured_reviews.name: Musafir Hun Yaaron
featured_reviews.review_text:
The University of Mumbai, established in 1857, is one of India’s oldest and most prestigious institutions. It offers a diverse range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs across disciplines such as science, commerce, arts, management, engineering, law, and social sciences.  ￼ ￼

The university operates primarily from two campuses: the Fort Campus, known for its historic Rajabai Clock Tower, and the expansive Kalina Campus, which spans 243 acres and provides a serene environment conducive to learning and research.  ￼

Students have access to comprehensive facilities, including separate hostels for boys and girls, well-furnished rooms, spacious classrooms, and full-time internet connectivity.  The Jawaharlal Nehru Library serves as a central resource, housing an extensive collection of academic materials.  ￼ ￼

The university has produced notable alumni who have significantly contributed to various fields. However, some students have expressed concerns regarding placement opportunities, citing limited campus recruitment and lower salary packages.  Despite these challenges, the University of Mumbai remains a prominent educational institution, blending historical significance with academic diversity. ￼
